definitions.explanation: The person who conducts an interview, typically in job recruitment or academic admissions contexts.

examples.japanese: {面接官|めんせつかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked a question by the interviewer.

examples.japanese: {面接官|めんせつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: The impression of the interviewer was very good.

examples.japanese: {面接官|めんせつかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{角度|かくど}→角度：00156_kakudo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}して→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧きた。
examples.english: There were three interviewers, and each asked questions from a different angle.

notes:
USAGE:
The {官|かん} suffix indicates a person in an official role. Used in job interview and university entrance exam contexts. The person being interviewed is {面接者|めんせつしゃ} or {受験者|じゅけんしゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {面接官|めんせつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧ (interviewer's question)
- {面接官|めんせつかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{好印象|こういんしょう}→好印象：19303_kouinshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ (to make a good impression on the interviewer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {試験官|しけんかん}: examiner — for written or practical exams
- ⟦{審査員|しんさいん}→審査員：28227_shinsain⟧: judge, evaluator — broader judging contexts
